description: Every app this connection can see: slug (pass it as app to other tools), name, URL, state, 30-day uptime (from uptimeSince for a younger app), latest response time, its group (when the account uses groups) and its page in BugOtter. Pass group for one group's apps.

group.description: Only the apps in this group: its slug or name (list_groups shows them). Leave out for every app.

name: list_apps
title: List apps
